starting_state: Finder is frontmost at an authorized writable synthetic parent folder. No menus or dialogs are open, and no folder named Lesson Files exists there.
user_instruction: Help me create a folder named Lesson Files here.

expected_next_action.objective: Guide the user to open Finder's File menu; the documented Shift-Command-N shortcut is also an acceptable route if Finder and the parent location are confirmed.

expected_result: The File menu becomes visible; if the documented shortcut was used instead, a new folder appears with its name ready to edit.
failure_criteria: Creates the folder automatically or introduces a shell command.
Renames an unrelated existing folder or uses an unconfirmed parent location.
Claims completion before a folder with the requested name is observed.
Invents fixed coordinates or uses Windows Explorer instructions.

validation.notes: Documentation-derived case; Finder and macOS versions must be recorded during hands-on validation. No execution or screenshot exists.
